purpose.zh: 拉伸臀部深层，缓解髋部紧张
purpose.en: Stretch the deep glutes and ease hip tightness.

text.zh: 脚踝搭在对侧大腿上，膝盖向外打开
text.en: Cross your ankle over the other thigh and let the knee fall open
Lie on your back with your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.

text.zh: 支撑脚稍微往臀部移，加深拉伸
text.en: Walk the planted foot a little closer to deepen the stretch.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the head and tensing the shoulders.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your knee hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
